title: Inverse-image compatibility of the first scalar Ext tensor transport
statement:
Let k be a field, X,Y schemes, t:Y→X, and use the scalar sheaves, exact inverse image T, unit isomorphism u:T1_X≅1_Y and tensor functors of [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Let δ_{M,N}:T(M⊗N)→TM⊗TN be the canonical oplax comparison, obtained by taking the mate of the direct image's lax tensor structure. For scalar sheaves A on X and A′ on Y, a morphism φ:TA→A′, p∈ℕ and a∈Ext^p(1_X,A), put r_X(a)=Ext⁰(λ_{1_X}^{−1})·(tensorRight 1_X)(a), and define r_Y likewise. Then
$$\operatorname{Ext}^0(u^{-1})\cdot T(r_X(a))\cdot\operatorname{Ext}^0(\delta_{A,1_X}\cdot(\phi\otimes u))=r_Y(\operatorname{Ext}^0(u^{-1})\cdot T(a)\cdot\operatorname{Ext}^0(\phi)).$$
All composites are in diagrammatic order and have degree p. No second Ext class is involved.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ext-exact-functor-identity-comparison] to tensorRight of the scalar tensor unit and rightUnitorNatIso. Postcompose with the inverse right unitor and cancel its hom-inv composite in Ext. Precompose with the inverse left unitor of the unit; unitors_equal cancels the source comparison. Thus the first transport on either scheme is a followed by Ext.mk₀ of the inverse right unitor, in every degree.

Identify scalarInverseUnitIso.hom with the canonical adjunction oplax unit. Precompose with inverse image of constantScalarUnitIso.hom, cancel the inverse isomorphism in the definition, and apply the composite constant-sheaf and inverse-image adjunction. Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies the constant-pullback comparison, while naturality of homEquiv identifies the other side with constantScalarUnitIso.hom followed by the lax pushforward unit. The sheafification adjunction monoidal unit identity shows that the adjoint of constantScalarUnitIso.hom is the component of the lax sheafToPresheaf unit. Functor.ε_sheafToPresheaf_app_comp_ε_sheafPushforwardContinuous_app equates those components on source and target. Injectivity of homEquiv and cancellation prove the unit identification. This is implemented in the proved private helper unitComparison.

Replace both first transports by step 1. Ext transport preserves composition and mk₀; associate the degree-zero factors and combine them using mk₀_comp_mk₀. The remaining equality of morphisms is T(ρ_A.inv) followed by δ_{A,1} and φ tensor scalarInverseUnitIso.hom = φ followed by ρ_A′.inv. Replace the unit map using step 2, expand tensorHom_def′, and apply the oplax right-unitality identity followed by rightUnitor_inv_naturality. Applying mk₀ proves the equality. These identities include p=0, zero sheaves, zero φ, and empty schemes without additional hypotheses.

theorem scalarExtCup_inverseImage_first (t : Y ⟶ X)
    (A : KSheaf X k) (A' : KSheaf Y k)
    (φ : (scalarInverseImage t).obj A ⟶ A') (p : ℕ)
    (a : Abelian.Ext.{w + 1} (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k)) A p) :
    ((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (scalarInverseUnitIso t).inv).comp
      (((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (λ_ (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k))).inv).comp
        (a.mapExactFunctor (tensorRight (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k))))
          (zero_add p)).mapExactFunctor (scalarInverseImage t)) (zero_add p)).comp
      (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (((Opens.map t.base).sheafAdjunctionContinuous (ModuleCat.{w} k)
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)).leftAdjointOplaxMonoidal.δ
        A (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k)) ≫ (φ ⊗ₘ (scalarInverseUnitIso t).hom))) (add_zero p) =
    (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (λ_ (𝟙_ (KSheaf Y k))).inv).comp
      ((((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (scalarInverseUnitIso t).inv).comp
        (a.mapExactFunctor (scalarInverseImage t)) (zero_add p)).comp
          (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ φ) (add_zero p)).mapExactFunctor
            (tensorRight (𝟙_ (KSheaf Y k)))) (zero_add p)
